create_MLP_model: create an MLP model with configurable hidden layers, dropout, and batch normalization
build_MLP_from_config: build an MLP model instance from a dictionary config with input_dim, output_dim, and hidden_dims
run_MLP_forward: run a forward pass through the MLP model on a PyTorch tensor input
test_MLP_with_batchnorm: test the MLP model with batch normalization enabled on all hidden layers
review_MLP_dropout: review the MLP model dropout configuration including first_dropout and per-layer dropout settings
